scientific_integrity: Proof is exact and unconditional. Finite computer checks corroborate sample fibers but do not establish the general theorem. Possible earlier equivalent formulations remain; no third-party validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: A complete criterion is proved for a fixed ordered finite word of prime supports, not an unrestricted classification of possible periodic words or a global count over all words. Known fixed points and the numerical example (1330,1550) are cited as prior data, not new findings. The stated growth estimate applies to one fixed fiber and is not asserted uniformly over words.
title: Exact prime-support fibers of periodic Dedekind-psi dynamics
